profile.name: Thayagapriyan Dravidamani
profile.lede: I am a systems integration lead with over ten years of experience connecting enterprise platforms — Salesforce, SAP S4/HANA, Hybris and AS400. I design API-led integration layers on MuleSoft, establish the security and observability patterns teams build on, and automate the pipelines that deliver them. Most recently I have extended that work into agent runtimes on AWS Bedrock.

experience.title: Systems Integration Lead
experience.detail: I lead integration architecture and delivery for enterprise programs spanning Salesforce, SAP S4/HANA and e-commerce. I designed the integration layer that migrated a strategic accounts platform to SAP S4/HANA, transforming source data into a canonical model before publishing it through OData and SOAP services. I also resolved a critical pipeline constraint by implementing streaming for payloads above 10 MB over Kafka within Mule, and established the platform's reusable security patterns using AWS Signature V4 and Salesforce JWT authentication with RSA key pairs.

experience.title: Senior MuleSoft Developer
experience.detail: I delivered integration solutions for clients in the warranty, insurance and financial services sectors, progressing from developer to technical lead during the engagement. My work included a contract-first SOAP integration that aggregated dealer data from Salesforce with pricing from Big Machines, a document service that generated and merged multiple PDFs while logging every payload for audit compliance, and an integration with JPMorgan Chase payment services for authorization lifecycle management.

experience.title: MuleSoft Developer
experience.detail: I implemented one of the account's earliest API-led architectures, routing all mobile application traffic through Mule across distinct Experience, Process and System layers. This became the reference pattern for subsequent projects. I also built the retail and supply chain pipelines behind it, including an automated Hybris-to-AS400 product feed via Amazon S3 and a loyalty program API integrating Hybris with the Airpoints backend.
